lede: Wat Pa Pao accounts for 21 catalogued manuscripts. It clusters in Chiang Mai (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (100%) are written in Shan · อักษรไทใหญ่ script. By support it leans to mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (86%) over khoi paper · กระดาษข่อย (14%). Dated witnesses run 1888–2001 CE (13 of 21 carry a date).
